profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Full Stack Developer with nearly a decade of hands-on experience in developing scalable web solutions.  I primarily write code in PHP and JavaScript, with a focus on Object Oriented Programming within an MVC architecture. I believe in writing clean, efficient code, that not only meets technical requirements but also enhances a user's experience. As a Full Stack Developer, I've had the opportunity to transition between coding server-side logic and designing responsive, user-friendly interfaces which has given me unique challenges along the way.

Though I have a passion for coding, I equally enjoy the great outdoors. If I'm not at my computer, you'll likely find me fishing from a kayak or enjoying quality time with my daughter at the park.

positions.title: Founder & Lead Developer
positions.description:
- Obtaining new clients and updating their web presence to their needs.
- SEO, rebranding, custom reports, cron jobs, data sync, and website backups.
- Establishing an online presence for businesses through responsive websites,
landing pages, Google Ads, social media ads, and email marketing.
- Connecting websites to different SaaS tools and managing customer marketing
campaigns after project launch.
- Hosting, SSL certification installations, SMTP, DNS Setup, and daily backups.
- Launched a Laravel project on Azure that included a payment portal developed
alongside the stripe.js API

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
As manager at Snap Fitness, it was my job to keep the gym clean, keep gym members happy and to recruit new prospects for the gym on a daily basis. I was also in charge of leading our social media presence through Facebook, Twitter and YouTube.

I left this position to pursue my education at Full Sail University for Web Design and Development.

positions.title: Data Entry, Recruiter, IT
positions.description:
SHCC is a Market Research facility. I started with them as Data Entry, after a few weeks I was also given the responsibilities of a recruiter. My job was to recruit specific demographics to meet our client's needs. As soon as the recruiting was completed, I worked in the kitchen or on the "Testing Floor".
I was also in charge of running take home studies, where testers would come to our facility weekly and pick up products to try at home. Each week I was in charge of organizing all the product by ID's to give to the proper tester. I was also the Data Entry for the completed surveys, as well as the IT for the 20+ computers that were used for each study.
